notes.title: Update 9-22-25
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added new button interaction tooltips, these are enabled by default and can be disabled from the options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to the opening scene of 'control lapse.'[/p][/*][*][p]Small change to level geometry on the right side of 'lobby'.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered enemy spawns/corruption rate in corruption mode.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 9-7-25
notes.content:
[list][*][p]Disabled vibration when a controller is connected but keyboard is being used. 
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain bot animations unintentionally playing on level load.
[/p][/*][*][p]Repositioned a music trigger in warehouse.
[/p][/*][*][p]Repositioned several objects near the beginning of abiotic jungle.
[/p][/*][*][p]Small change to the beginning of jobsite.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Quality of life update 8-24-25
notes.content:
[p][b]This update is focusing on quality of life changes to make gameplay smoother and make dying less frustrating.[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Cinematics that play at the start of a level no longer replay after the player's death[/p][/*][*][p]A hidden checkpoint system has been added to areas where player death could result in too large a loss of progress[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes:[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Enemy bots no longer target uncontrollable bots with commandmods[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with commandmods where combat music could continue to play with no enemies present[/p][/*][*][p]Behavior of idle robots when trapped in narrow areas is improved[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a way for an achievement to be awarded prematurely
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ENTERING HOST IS OUT NOW
notes.content: [h3][b]Entering Host has officially released![/b][/h3][p]Prepare to [i]CRAWL[/i], [i]CONTROL[/i], and uncover the [i]CHAOS[/i] of a city that got a little too comfortable with their robots.[/p][h1][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3677860/Entering_Host/" style="button" buttoncolor="#1e9461"]GET ENTERING HOST[/url][/b][/h1][previewyoutube="oD1gJlR8Ek4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Entering Host is the result of years of... very slow development. I am so excited to finally be able to share this project with you.[/p][p]Some of the puzzles can be pretty tricky. Don't be afraid to reach out to the community if you're stuck![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45641525/91f6ea463535809ba43be1f70934669bc7179fb2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]HAVE FEEDBACK OR NOTICE A BUG?[/b][/h3][p]Please post a discussion! There is a subforum for responding to any technical issues with a start here message.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]THANK YOU[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45641525/c43c43a29aaffa8e59c2031b784622d0a74862e3.png"][/img][/p]
